verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents color configuration in its TOML config using #RRGGBB hex values. It also supports importing additional config files and live config reload, which together allow swapping color schemes. Nothing in the pack shows automatic light/dark mode switching or a documented theme/scheme system. Missing for 10: automatic light/dark mode switching, explicit documented theme/color-scheme support (named palettes, theme files), independent corroboration of theming.
